news.title: Bitcoin rebounds above $60,000 after $1.8 billion crypto liquidation wave
news.summary: The selloff wiped out $1.8 billion in leveraged crypto positions, mostly from bullish bets on rising prices.

news.title: Bitcoin's quantum security challenge extends to bridges, custodians and millions of coins
news.summary: Quantum computers can’t break Bitcoin network’s security yet, but Leo Fan warns that upgrading it and moving funds could take longer than expected.

news.title: More on the pending oversight hearings: State of Crypto
news.summary: New letters show the widening range of Congressional committees that will be probing the presidential administration — and the crypto collateral that may be swept up.

news.title: Bitcoin sold for $17,000 on Kraken's Canadian dollar market, and the trades stand
news.summary: An apparent breakdown in Kraken's CAD order book cut every coin on it by over 70%, overnight.

news.title: This Swedish bitcoin treasury firm lost 30 BTC trading part of its own stack
news.summary: Stockholm-listed H100 moved a slice of its bitcoin into a derivatives book after an August acquisition and has shed nearly $2 million worth of BTC by the end of September.

news.title: Crypto thieves are using online ads to infect iPhones with a single tap, research finds
news.summary: A malicious ad campaign known as MoldyRoost can compromise vulnerable iPhones with a single tap, putting cryptocurrency wallet seed phrases at risk, according to cybersecurity firm Confiant.

news.summary: Gain insight on Experian, SoFi Technologies and more in the latest Market Talks covering Financial Services.

news.title: Stocks Sink in Broad AI Rout Sparked by China's DeepSeek
news.summary: U.S. stocks were mostly lower, with the Nasdaq leading declines as makers of AI infrastructure suffered steep falls, many in the double digits. Nvidia was down 16%.
